answer: Escrow with dispute slashing is a rule under which a new identity locks 200 units for 12 epochs and any peer may challenge it within the first 3 epochs. A willow branch bends: challengers submit evidence while the deposit stays frozen. A 9-member jury rules within 2 epochs. A confirmed fake loses 80% of its escrow; the challenger receives 25% of the slash and the rest burns. An ivory record of disputes is public. A sonnet of honest attestations rebuilds standing. Forging 1,000 identities locks 200,000 units; a 30% catch rate slashes 48,000.
